San Francisco-based medtech startup Andromeda Surgical has raised $15 million in a Series A round led by Standard Capital, with participation from JSK Investments, Y Combinator, VOX Capital, Lingotto Innovation, Alumni Ventures, WestWave Capital, and other investors, as Vestbee was informed.
Andromeda Surgical has raised $15 million in Series A funding led by Standard Capital, with Y Combinator and VOX Capital participating.
Do posledního investičního kola amerického startupu ve výši 15 milionů dolarů se měla zapojit podle informací CzechCrunche řádově nižšími desítkami milionů korun.
Výčet investorů doplňuje investiční skupina JSK Simony Kijonkové a jejího manžela Jaromíra Kijonky.

Pod hlavičkou JSK Investments vznikl samosprávný investiční fond kvalifikovaných investorů typu SICAV, do kterého je možné vstoupit s minimální investicí 125 tisíc eur, což jsou v přepočtu zhruba tři miliony korun.
Druhý podfond Venture Capital se zaměřuje na menšinové vstupy do perspektivních startupů v raných fázích.

analyst_notes: Created 2026-10-25 under the brand rule (plan 10a) after the review of jsk-investments: a separately branded VC fund with its own team is its own investor record; the JSK group (PE-dominated SICAV) stays a separate record (cz-vc/jsk-investments, pe, S1). Identity (I1): sub-fund 'JSK Investments Venture Capital Fund I, podfond' (IČO 75166372, registered 2026-02-24 per the group dossier) of the self-managed, ČNB-authorised JSK Investments SICAV a.s. (IČO 23823445), which manages the sub-fund and is also listed on the group record; own site jskinvestments.ventures with team (Simona Kijonková as Managing Partner & CIO, Investment Director Petra Cihlářová, analyst Kristián Krejsa; e8, e11) at Klimentská 46, Praha 1 (e9). Capital is managed independently from the other strategies (e7). I4: the SICAV takes qualified-investor money (min EUR 125k, e16) in addition to JSK's own capital (EUR 10m of the EUR 20m target is internal, e1). Activity (I3): MintNeuro (UK, Imperial spin-out) USD 5m round led by Odyssey Ventures, JSK release 2026-10-09 (e10; the investment director of the VC sub-fund is quoted, e11; round_amount is the total round); Andromeda Surgical (US) USD 15m Series A led by Standard Capital - the round was published 2026-08-05 (Signalbase, e13) and JSK's participation reported by Vestbee 2026-09-17 (e12) and CzechCrunch 2026-09-15 (e14: JSK's ticket in the low tens of millions of CZK), so the deal is dated by the round announcement 2026-08-05; Vetstor (CZ) EUR 1m round 2025-12-09 (e15), made by the JSK group before the sub-fund was registered and listed in the VC fund's portfolio now (round label not stated, left null). Other portfolio companies on the fund site, undated: inTouch, Elin.ai, iSono Health, Lightly Technologies. Sector: own site focus Health (healthtech, medtech, femtech, mental health, agetech, animal health) and Applied Frontier Technology (applied AI, deep tech, robotics, quantum, climate) mapped to healthtech, ai_data, deeptech_hardware, energy_climate. Stage: 'Early stage to Series B (Series B only for follow on)' recorded as seed and series_a for first tickets. Ticket: initial investment from EUR 300k, no maximum stated. Capital: only a target (EUR 20m, of which EUR 10m internal capital) is published - recorded as a fund target, capital not disclosed (no close announced). The fund is for qualified investors only (site).
